capabilities.operation_scope: Create or author a Standard Copilot Studio agent through a verified Microsoft-supported authoring surface.
Inspect, synchronize, update, publish, or manage an agent where supported and approved.
Exercise the agent through an approved supported test/conversation path and retain evidence.
Author through the newer GHCP-style harness only after architecture and compatibility gates pass.
Discover supported connectors, connections, and operations required by the approved task.
Create a flow for approved deterministic multi-step behavior.
Modify an existing flow after inspecting ownership, solution status, and current state.
Validate flow configuration and behavior using the supported platform path.
Check environment, connection, operation, and policy prerequisites before build/run.
Execute an approved flow operation in the confirmed Development environment.
Inspect health, run outcomes, and failure causes for an existing flow.
Inspect or change Dataverse metadata through a verified supported skill/tool.
Read or change Dataverse records only when approved requirements justify it.
Inspect security roles and data access; permission changes require explicit authorization.
Perform approved environment administration through a verified authorized path.
Inspect solution contents and ownership; use PAC for solution ALM operations where suitable.
Plan and run supported Microsoft agent evaluation, interpret results, and route remediation.
Initialize, validate, pack, export, import, or promote solution artifacts through supported ALM operations.
